groups.title: Wide-belt deburring machines · value line
groups.lead: Entry-level wide-belt deburring and finishing machines, 12″ and 24″ — NovoTech value line, built in China.

intro_add: For the shop that starts deburring by machine, the NovoTech value-line MGM-300 (12″) and BFM-2560 (24″, with a wet dust collector) are wide-belt machines for laser-cut and punched parts.
